intended_object: For a t-structure t on a pretriangulated category C and an integer n, the canonical natural transformation X → τ_{≥n} X from the identity functor to the truncation functor τ_{≥n}. It is the second morphism of the functorial distinguished triangle τ_{<n}X → X → τ_{≥n}X → τ_{<n}X[1]. This is inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation:
`TruncAux.triangleFunctor t n` sends each X to a distinguished triangle A → X → B → A[1], with A ≤ n−1 and B ≥ n. It is made functorial by the uniqueness of morphisms between such triangles (`triangle_map_ext`). `truncGE n` is the third projection of this triangle functor. `truncGEπ` whiskers `Triangle.π₂Toπ₃` (the natural map obj₂ → obj₃) with the triangle functor, so its component at X is the map X → τ_{≥n}X in the truncation triangle. This is exactly the standard truncation morphism.

The setting is right: an arbitrary pretriangulated category with an arbitrary t-structure, indexed by ℤ, which is the standard generality. The construction is a natural transformation between functors C ⥤ C, so there is nothing to generalize.
